metadata.note: Heat-exchanger primaries (41 mm OD) into two 3-into-1 collectors; the far bank crosses over to the single-entry KKK K27 turbine, represented by its throat (36 mm, 0.1 m); the closed wastegate path is not represented; intermediate pipe through the rear silencer to one tailpipe. Pipes beyond the primaries' tube size are estimates. Silencer, catalyst and collector-box bodies are straight pipes of their inlet diameter. Valve: 41.5 mm (replacement listings), 10 mm lift (estimate), about 280 deg seat to seat (estimate from 50 BBDC / 18 ATDC at 1 mm).
